title: Design System: Christian Padilla, The Pipeline

headline.purpose: Section headings; one accent phrase may carry now-gold.

figure.purpose: A record value set as a number (hero 10+), tabular numerals.

body-lg.purpose: Header ledes beside section headings; hero lede from 1024px.

body.purpose: Ledes and long paragraphs in Quiet Ivory.

body-sm.purpose: Card and flip-card body, record and contact values.

ui.purpose: Primary and secondary buttons; nav wordmark.

ui-sm.purpose: Nav links, nav Contact pill, demo pills, captions and hints.

label.purpose: Record field labels and stage names, followed by a value; never an eyebrow above a heading.

label-micro.purpose: Stage line under the wordmark on phones and tablets only.

shadows.name: glass-float
shadows.purpose: Floating layers: nav, menus, dialog chrome, HUD, carousel arrows, rail tooltips (with blur(20px) saturate(140%) over rgb(16 16 19 / 0.68)).

shadows.name: smoked-record
shadows.purpose: The record utility: smoked glass (rgb(14 14 17 / 0.58) under an ivory wash from 4.5% to 0, 8% ivory border), lit top edge, grounded bottom edge; no backdrop blur.

shadows.name: inner-edge
shadows.purpose: Lit top edge on raised non-record surfaces: workflow tiles and cover, slide cards, About portrait record, tech chips, portfolio tab track and view toggle, back-to-top disc, phone service cards.

shadows.name: edge-lit
shadows.purpose: The edge-lit utility: image wells nested inside a record.

shadows.name: gold-lit-edge
shadows.purpose: Top edge of a gold fill that is now or hovered: About primary pill, play button, solved-face icon disc, hovered contact discs, active portfolio tab thumb.

shadows.name: now-ring
shadows.purpose: Tight gold ring around a disc that is now or hovered: solved-face icon, play button (6px, 10px on hover), hovered service and contact icons. Never a blurred halo.

shadows.name: hero-record
shadows.purpose: Hero portrait record and showcase frames.

shadows.name: sheet-edge
shadows.purpose: Content sheet's upward shadow onto the hero.

shadows.name: loupe
shadows.purpose: Flowchart magnifier (outer drop plus inner falloff).

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: UI state changes, press, now-gold colour (700ms), rail stem.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals and hero entrances (900ms).

motion.name: ease-in-out-strong
motion.purpose: Scroll-cue chase light.

motion.name: ease-in-out-glide
motion.purpose: Key light gliding to the active stage (2.6s).

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Declared for sheets; unused in the shipped page.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every pressable element.

motion.name: tailwind-4-transitions
motion.purpose: Tailwind 4 scale and translate utilities set independent properties; a transform transition does not animate them.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity from 0.2 on 900ms ease-out-expo; y (22px default) and scale on a spring (visualDuration 0.85, bounce 0.16); blur 8px from 768px only, filter dropped after landing; once at -12% viewport margin. Records: y 26 to 36, scale 0.96 to 0.97, blur 8 to 10, stagger 60 to 70ms (Services from opacity 0.15).
motion.purpose: Content landing into view; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: signal
motion.value: signal 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) infinite (scale 1 to 3.2, opacity 0.55 to 0)
motion.purpose: Live status dots and the rail lead token.

motion.name: chase
motion.purpose: Scroll cue: one light down a hairline.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Tech-stack logo strip; pauses on hover, becomes a scrollable row under reduced motion.

motion.name: now-gold
motion.purpose: Heading accent turns gold while its section is active.

motion.name: aurora-drift
motion.purpose: Aurora ribbons below the hero; paused on the top stage, still on phones and coarse pointers, stopped under reduced motion.

motion.name: beam-sway
motion.value: beamSway 38s / 46s (delay -17s) ease-in-out infinite, rotate var(--beam-from) to var(--beam-to)
motion.purpose: Two keynote beams, desktop and tablet only; same pause and stop rules as the ribbons.

motion.name: key-light
motion.value: transform and opacity 2.6s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) to the per-stage RIG position
motion.purpose: Stage key light finds the section being read; instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: cursor-pool
motion.purpose: Broad 6% light pool trailing a mouse pointer across the stage; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: loupe-track
motion.value: spring stiffness 1000, damping 38, mass 0.3 on motion values
motion.purpose: Flowchart loupe follows the pointer without re-rendering.

motion.name: spotlight
motion.value: spring stiffness 420, damping 40, mass 0.6 (fade: stiffness 200, damping 30)
motion.purpose: Pointer-following sheen and masked lit edge on records; mouse only, motion values.

motion.name: magnet
motion.value: spring stiffness 240, damping 19, mass 0.6; smoothstep falloff; moves via CSS translate
motion.purpose: useMagnet field on controls (reach, strength, max, inner parallax); composes with the 0.97 press, releases on scroll, mouse only, off for reduced motion.

motion.name: shine
motion.purpose: Light sweep across primary gold pills on fine-pointer hover; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: loupe-enter
motion.value: 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), scale 0.9 to 1 with fade; exit 150ms
motion.purpose: Loupe appear/disappear; fade only under reduced motion.

motion.name: stage-dim
motion.purpose: Flowchart stage dims (never blurs) while the loupe inspects.

narrative.overview:
The page is Christian's own lead pipeline and the visitor is the lead moving through it. Ten stages sit on a hairline rail; one gold lead token advances as the visitor reads, the stages behind it fill in, and the journey lands on Get In Touch. The world is a keynote stage: near-black grounds stepping up to raised graphite, ivory type, stage lights below the hero (slow aurora ribbons, two swaying keynote beams, a key light that finds the section being read) and a fine film grain so large dark fields never band. Everything that is not "now" rests in ivory and graphite.

Density is generous and editorial. Sections breathe on one shared vertical rhythm; content sits in a 12-column grid inside an 80rem container. Hierarchy comes from scale (one family, Inter, set large, semibold and tight at headline sizes against quiet body text) and from the single reserved colour, never from boxes, badges or labels stacked above headings. Content is presented as records: cards read like CRM entries, with tracked caps field labels followed by their values.

The world refuses the dark-glass freelancer template: gradient headings, gold halos around buttons and cards, and interchangeable frosted cards. Glass exists as two disciplined materials: blurred chrome for layers that float above the page, and unblurred smoked glass, lit from above, for the records that hold content.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, champagne gold, spent only on what is current: the active stage, the lead token, primary actions, live signal pulses.
Hairline rules (1px ivory at 9% and 16%), lit inner top edges and black drop shadows define every surface; gold light on an element is only an inner edge or a tight ring on what is now.
One family, Inter Variable with optical sizing: semibold headings whose tracking tightens as size grows; regular text for everything readable; tracked caps for labels.
Pills for every action and chip; large soft-cornered records for content.
Motion is custom ease-out and spring physics: quick on press, landing with a whisper of overshoot on reveal and hover, and always yields to reduced motion.

rules.name: The Gold Is Now Rule
rules.body: Gold marks only what is current or what acts. Heading accent words rest in ivory and turn gold (700ms colour transition) only while their section is the active stage. Subtitles, tags, icons at rest, card borders at rest and body copy are never gold. Hover may borrow gold (borders at 30 to 50%, icon fills, the demo pill's fill, the Spotlight's lit edge) because hover is the visitor's "now". Gold light on an element follows the same law: inner edges and tight rings only (see The Black Shadow Rule).

rules.name: The One Static Keyline Exception
rules.body: The hero portrait record carries a permanent gold keyline (gold at 40%, inner ring at 25%) and its "10+" field in gold. It is the opening record of the pipeline; do not extend permanent gold keylines to other cards.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every word is Inter Variable. Headings (h1 to h6) are semibold (600) with balanced wrapping and tighten their tracking as they grow, from -0.022em at title size to -0.045em at display size; paragraphs wrap pretty. No second display face; the system fonts are fallbacks while Inter loads, never a choice.

rules.name: The Label-Then-Value Rule
rules.body: Tracked caps label a value that follows them. They never sit above a heading as a section kicker or eyebrow.

rules.name: The Shared Header Row Rule
rules.body: A section header that pairs a heading with a paragraph uses the 7/5 split, bottom-aligned (items-end), with the paragraph in Body Large Quiet Ivory. When a section has two such rows (Systems Showcase), both use the identical split, alignment and paragraph style so they read as one system.

rules.name: The Quiet Stage Rule
rules.body: The background must never compete with content. It sits behind a pointer-transparent layer and shows only below the hero. Ribbon cores stay at or under 26% and fall below 10% by mid-radius; beams stay under 20% at their source and are blurred; the key light holds at 10% and the pointer pool at 6%; all of it reads through the content sheet's 22% Stage Black. Drift loops run 38 seconds or longer (ribbons 64 to 78s) and beams sway no more than 9 degrees. Ribbons and beams pause while the hero covers them, hold still on phones and coarse pointers, and stop under prefers-reduced-motion (the key light then jumps instead of gliding). If a light is noticeable while reading, it is too strong.

rules.name: The Black Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every drop shadow is black. Gold light appears on an element only as an inner edge or a tight ring (5 to 10px, at most 14%), and only on what is now or hovered: the active portfolio tab thumb, the flipped solution face lit from above with a gold inset rim, the play button ring, hovered icon discs, and the Spotlight's lit edge under the cursor. One sanctioned bloom: the active portfolio tab thumb pools a soft gold light beneath itself (0 10px 24px -10px, gold at 60%), the single "switched on" control on the page. No gradient text, no text-shadow, no other gold halo or blurred gold glow, and no gold on a card at rest (the Mermaid node drop-shadows are stripped for this reason). Broad gold light otherwise exists only as ambient stage light: the background layers and the content sheet's rim.

rules.name: The Two Glasses Rule
rules.body: Glass comes in two materials, never mixed. Chrome glass (`glass`: graphite at 68%, 20px blur, 140% saturation, 10% ivory border, glass-float shadow) is only for layers that float: nav, menus, dialog chrome, HUD, carousel arrows, rail tooltips; the phone sticky section headers are its frosted cousin (Stage Black at 90%, 12px blur, hairline bottom edge). Smoked glass (`record`: graphite rgb(14 14 17) at 58% under an ivory wash falling from 4.5% to nothing, an 8% ivory border, a lit top inset edge at 9% and a grounded black bottom inset edge) is for content records; it takes no backdrop blur, so the stage lights read through the tint. Image wells nested in a record take `edge-lit` (a 10% top highlight and a 5% inner keyline).

dos: **Do** reserve gold for the current stage, the lead token, primary actions, live signals, focus and hover; keep heading accents in ivory until their section is active.
**Do** separate surfaces with 1px hairlines (ivory at 9% or 16%) and pure black drop shadows with negative spread, and let raised surfaces catch light on a thin inset top edge.
**Do** set every word in Inter Variable, headings semibold on the type-scale steps with tracking that tightens as size grows.
**Do** label record fields with 11px tracked caps (0.14em) followed by their value.
**Do** use full pills for anything pressable or naming a thing, and 24 to 32px corners for content records.
**Do** give every pressable element the 0.97 press scale with a 180ms ease-out-quint transition, a 2px gold focus outline at 3px offset, and a 44px minimum touch target.
**Do** reveal content from faint (opacity 0.15 to 0.2, blur from 768px), never from invisible, landing on a spring, and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
**Do** keep every section on the shared stage padding (clamp 72px to 120px).
**Do** keep the background quiet: faint ribbons and blurred beams below the hero only, loops of 38s or longer, paused under the hero, still on phones, stopped under reduced motion.
**Do** show product mockups whole: square frames, contained, never cropped.
**Do** light what is now from within: gold inner edges and tight rings on active or hovered elements only.
donts: **Don't** put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading; stage names live in the nav readout and on the pipeline rail.
**Don't** use gradient text, text-shadow, coloured drop shadows or gold halos; gold on an element is an inner edge or a tight ring, never on a card at rest.
**Don't** give content records backdrop blur or chrome glass; chrome glass is only for floating layers (nav, menus, dialog chrome, HUD, carousel arrows), and records are unblurred smoked glass.
**Don't** colour subtitles, tags, resting icons or resting card borders gold.
**Don't** use built-in ease-in curves; state changes ease out.
**Don't** add a second typeface or let a system font stand in as a design choice.
**Don't** let the background compete with content, and don't blur the stage behind a focused element; dim it (the flowchart to 30%, the funnel track's other records to 55%).
